items.title: Nvidia Rolls Out New Tools to Keep AI Agents in Line
items.summary: Nvidia is rolling out two open-source software security tools designed to control what AI agents can access in real time and shut them down when they break the rules. The company says this would've prevented the recent high-profile breach of Hugging Face by OpenAI's artificial intelligence models. Neil Campling reports on Bloomberg Television.
